scope: Diagnostic native skeletal-format assessment using the unchanged accepted Domingo source and seven module identities; no production migration.

presentation.scope:
Compare identical peaceful cohorts using MD3, IQM and retained-cape hybrid bindings.

These are uncapped queue presentation measurements and simulation tails in an
isolated room, not display latency, combat performance or author acceptance.

viewer.qualification: Automated bounded viewer smoke; not an author session or acceptance.

independent_binary_audit.qualification: Independent float64 reconstruction checks serialized geometry, hierarchy, weights and frames. The reported float32 comparison bound is 64 operations per hierarchy level times machine epsilon and coordinate magnitude; it addresses arithmetic reconstruction differences only, not visual acceptance or a permitted deformation change. Source-pipeline and encoding differences remain in the Blender export report. Native rendering/interpolation and author review are separate.

review.finding: Standing, melee, seated cape, death transition, horizontal sleeping and crouching remain coherently assembled in these inspected pairs. Pure IQM retains the separately measured cape thickness difference; images do not establish byte or geometric equivalence. No author acceptance. Jump preparation and running guard pairs were also directly inspected. Guard jump and saved hidden-hair/shield views were also inspected. All six benchmark scenes retain the intended visible cohort/camera; the bounded walking viewer and its controls label were inspected. Fractional interpolation and every image are not claimed pixel-equivalent.

engine_environment: Vulkan device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti
environment.native_settings: 1280x720 Vulkan; noautoload; unpaused hidden background; 5% audio. Preview capped60; presentation uncapped, vsync off.
environment.measurement_isolation: One native engine at a time. No heavy exports/builds/full project validation during captures or measurements. A separate bounded SYSTEM_REQUIRED lease prevents sleep for the ongoing author-requested work session; it is released when that session ends.

qualifications: The independent reader reconstructs 4,008,375 sampled vertices; source-pipeline and encoding differences are separately measured. Numeric roundoff bounds are not author-approved artistic tolerances.
Pure IQM bakes cape thickness at rest; the source applies it after deformation. Hybrid retains the exact original MD3 cape and six skeletal modules.
The ten export files repeat byte for byte. Nine raw files are tracked; the private overlay package is rebuilt deterministically from them.
All 160 final capture hashes are retained, but only listed images were directly inspected; unselected captures remain in the local build directory and can be regenerated.

The reviewed set contains20 final comparison views, all six benchmark scenes and one walking viewer. Sampled geometry checks do not establish exact equivalence between fractional skeletal and vertex interpolation.

At64 figures MD3 produced873.40 queue presents/s versus236.24 pure IQM and246.13 hybrid. The smaller candidates are not recommended for production migration; the cause of the measured regression is not isolated by this assessment.

Six single700-tic peaceful measurements compare 1/64 figures in an identical room/camera. Queue intervals are not monitor latency, GPU execution time, siege/campaign performance or statistical generalization.
The viewer check is automated, not author acceptance. All previous author tests remain pending; no final consolidated terminal is handed off.
Existing source art, MD3s, state timing, collision/equipment/save owners are unchanged. No other species/sexes, first-person equipment, new balance or story is introduced.
